evidence: Labeled 'Mining', alters src/node/miner.cpp, and extends interfaces::Mining to assemble and validate external templates.
rationale: Extends the mining interface to allow Stratum v2 Job Declarator Servers to validate external block templates without maintaining duplicate out-of-process mempool mirrors. Removing full-template IPC roundtrips reduces bandwidth and eliminates the race condition where transactions leave the mempool during validation, directly unblocking stratum-mining/sv2-apps #599.
